extensionDescription.message: Insert saved HTML templates into the message you are writing. Group them, pick them from a panel or the context menu, and insert the first ten with Cmd/Ctrl+1 to 0.

libraryDamaged.message: The saved templates could not be read. Open "Manage templates".

errorPlainText.message: Templates work only in HTML messages.

errorInsertFailed.message: The template could not be inserted.

selectHint.message: Select a template or a group, or create a new one.

emptyLibrary.message: No templates yet. Create one or import your Quicktext templates.

confirmDeleteGroup.message: Delete the group "$1" with all its templates ($2)?

imageTooLarge.message: This image is $1. Every email with this template grows by that size.

importFileLabel.message: Quicktext export (JSON or XML) or Quicktext Lite backup

importFlatten.message: Turn Quicktext groups that hold a single template with the same name into top-level templates

importSummaryTags.message: Templates with Quicktext tags, which are inserted as plain text: $1.

importErrorUnknownFormat.message: This file is neither a Quicktext export nor a Quicktext Lite backup.

importErrorInvalid.message: The file could not be read: $1

loadFailed.message: The templates could not be loaded ($1). Close this tab and open "Manage templates" again.

damagedData.message: The saved templates could not be read ($1). Nothing has been changed.

confirmStartEmpty.message: Replace the unreadable data with an empty library? Download the raw data first if you want to keep it.
